$schema: this file has no external schema — see FetchSherpaNativeTask.kt's doc comment for the shape a parser accepts
note: R-1001 (WPJ): the sherpa-onnx-jvm JAR (gradle/libs.versions.toml's sherpaOnnx coordinate,
asr-sherpa/build.gradle.kts) supports Android deliberately (LibraryUtils.load() skips
loadFromResourceInJar() on Android and calls System.loadLibrary("sherpa-onnx-jni") directly —
see WPJ's build report for the disassembly) but the project never shipped the .so files that
call resolves to. This manifest is the single source of truth for those native libraries,
fetched at build time by buildSrc's FetchSherpaNativeTask into
app/src/main/jniLibs/<abi>/ (gitignored, like app/src/main/assets/bundled/) — never committed.
archiveUrl is upstream's own published, public (no HF_TOKEN, no auth of any kind) GitHub
release asset for exactly this sherpa-onnx-jvm version — see
https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/tag/v1.13.7 and
https://k2-fsa.github.io/sherpa/onnx/android/build-sherpa-onnx.html, which names this exact
artifact. It is a single tar.bz2 containing jniLibs/<abi>/*.so for five ABIs; this project
extracts only the two it ships (see 'libraries' below) and only the two files each of those
ABIs' JNI binding actually needs — libonnxruntime.so is the only DT_NEEDED entry
libsherpa-onnx-jni.so declares beyond the Android system libraries (confirmed by inspecting
its dynamic symbol table with pyelftools in WPJ's build report; libsherpa-onnx-c-api.so and
libsherpa-onnx-cxx-api.so, also present in the archive, are for native C/C++ API consumers
this project does not use and are never fetched).
sha256/sizeBytes below were computed directly from a real download and extraction of this
exact archiveUrl in WPJ's own session (see that build report) — not read from published
metadata, since GitHub does not publish per-asset checksums for release tarballs.
Unlike bundled-assets.json's FetchBundledAssetsTask, this fetch has no allow-missing escape
hatch and is never gated behind -PortAllowMissingBundledAssets: the archive needs no token,
costs a few tens of megabytes (not hundreds), and a build that silently shipped without these
libraries is the exact defect this manifest exists to close (register R-1001).
